name: EDC Las Vegas, Kinetic Field
what: More than 30 high-power laser systems on the main stage: RTI NANO and PIKO projectors on Lasergraph DSP with a grandMA2.

name: Ultra Music Festival
what: Over 30 laser projectors above 20 W each across seven stages, all on Pangolin BEYOND (software maker's account).

name: Dubai Light Up 2018
what: About seven minutes of light and lasers replaced the fireworks; Guinness's largest light and sound show on a single building, 109,252 square meters.

name: Glastonbury 2019, The Chemical Brothers
what: 18 Kinekt, 12 Viper deLuxe, 4 Beamburst, a Phaenon X Pro 30000 and a Tripan for the Saturday headliner (company's own list).

name: Swedish House Mafia at Coachella
what: Lasers built into a circular structure over the DJs for aerial beams; the design carried over to the tour (software maker's account).

name: Illenium, Trilogy
who: Brad Kellogg, Bill Loftus, Polar Productions
what: 147 laser systems totaling more than 4,000 W, including a 270 W Kvant EPIC, February 2 and 3, 2024 (software maker's account).

name: Disney Tales of Magic
what: A 20-minute nighttime show reusing the lasers used on the Eiffel Tower at the Paris 2024 opening ceremony.

name: Anyma, The End of Genesys
what: A Sphere run from February 27 to March 2, 2025 with lasers moving with the drops; no supplier named.

name: Coachella and Stagecoach
what: Lasers on six Coachella stages, PASS audience-scanning units on three, and Stagecoach's first lasers (software maker's account).

name: Swedish House Mafia 3.0 opening show
what: 26 Kvant units: 12 Atom 58, 12 Atom 42 and two Spectrum 55 (software maker's account).

name: 49ers Bay Area Rock & Roll Laser Halftime Show
what: An eight-minute laser halftime show on December 28, 2025.

name: Laser Lightfall, Vivid Sydney
what: Vivid Sydney's first laser show: 23 nights, seven-minute shows, four an hour.

name: New Years Eve Eskilstuna 2026
what: Winner of ILDA's 2026 Corporate Show award.
